messages.subject: Posterior Predictive Check Help!!
parts:
Hi All,
I am still pretty new to working within the Bayesian framework, and using JAGS. I have been trying to figure out how to implement the posterior predictive check with the JAGS code below: 

# Specify model in BUGS language
sink("js-rest.occ.jags")
cat("
    model {

    # Priors and constraints

    for (i in 1:M){
    for (t in 1:(n.occasions-1)){
        logit(phi[i,t]) <- mean.1phi + epsilon[t]   ### <:3)~~~ epsilon = temporal variation in survival
    } #t
    for (t in 1:n.occasions){
        p[i,t] <- mean.p
    } #t
    } #i

    mean.p ~ dunif(0, 1)                        # mean capture rate
    mean.phi ~ dunif(0, 1)                      # mean survival rate
    
    for (t in 1:(n.occasions-1)){
        logit(annual.phi[t]) <- mean.1phi + epsilon[t]   ### <:3)~~~ annual survival
    } #t

    mean.1phi <- log(mean.phi/(1-mean.phi))     ### <:3)~~~
    for (t in 1:(n.occasions-1)){               
        epsilon[t] ~ dnorm(0,tau)               ### <:3)~~~
    }

    tau <- pow(sigma, -2)                       ### <:3)~~~
    sigma ~ dunif(0,1)                          # standard dev of variation in survival
    sigma2 <- pow(sigma,2)

    for (t in 1:n.occasions){
    gamma[t] ~ dunif(0, 1)
    } #t
    
    # Likelihood
    for (i in 1:M){
    # First occasion
    # State process
    z[i,1] ~ dbern(gamma[1])
    # Observation process
    mu1[i] <- z[i,1] * p[i,1]
    y[i,1] ~ dbern(mu1[i])
    # Subsequent occasions
    for (t in 2:n.occasions){
    # State process
    q[i,t-1] <- 1-z[i,t-1]        # Availability for recruitment
    mu2[i,t] <- phi[i,t-1] * z[i,t-1] + gamma[t] * prod(q[i,1:(t-1)])
    z[i,t] ~ dbern(mu2[i,t])
    # Observation process
    mu3[i,t] <- z[i,t] * p[i,t]
    y[i,t] ~ dbern(mu3[i,t])
    
    } #t
    } #i
    # Calculate derived population parameters
    for (t in 1:n.occasions){
    qgamma[t] <- 1-gamma[t]
    }
    cprob[1] <- gamma[1]
    for (t in 2:n.occasions){
    cprob[t] <- gamma[t] * prod(qgamma[1:(t-1)])
    } #t
    psi <- sum(cprob[])            # Inclusion probability
    for (t in 1:n.occasions){
    b[t] <- cprob[t] / psi      # Entry probability
    } #t
    for (i in 1:M){
    recruit[i,1] <- z[i,1]
    for (t in 2:n.occasions){
    recruit[i,t] <- (1-z[i,t-1]) * z[i,t]
    } #t
    } #i
    for (t in 1:n.occasions){
    N[t] <- sum(z[1:M,t])        # Actual population size
    B[t] <- sum(recruit[1:M,t])  # Number of entries
    } #t
    for (i in 1:M){
    Nind[i] <- sum(z[i,1:n.occasions])
    Nalive[i] <- 1-equals(Nind[i], 0)
    } #i
    Nsuper <- sum(Nalive[])         # Superpopulation size
    }
    ",fill=TRUE)
sink()

Would anyone be willing to help me with this problem or might have some resources that you would recommend?

Thank you in advance.
